# porch_tenant (Data Source)

Looks up a tenant by ID or slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porch_tenant" "smiths" {
  slug = "smiths"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tenant ID. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` must be set.
- `slug` (String) Tenant slug.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `session_absolute_seconds` (Number) Absolute lifetime override (0 = default).
- `session_idle_seconds` (Number) Idle timeout override (0 = default).
- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`.
